## Purpose

The project looks like a small browser-based app (index.html, style.css, plain JS modules, Dockerfile, run.sh) that draws something on a "court" in an isometric view, with files for iso projection, scaling, rendering, and a config. It could be a game or visualization, such as a sports court, but the file names alone don't confirm that. The many `.agents` and `.claude` skill files are guidance for AI coding agents (testing, debugging, review, etc.) and don't say what the app itself does.
